newsitem.title: MEXICO: Int'L Paper moves into Mexican sierra - paper.
newsitem.headline: Int'L Paper moves into Mexican sierra - paper.

text.p: U.S. lumber and paper giant International Paper Co is expanding into a range of northern Mexican mountains, La Jornada said Monday.

The company is working on a project in the Western Sierra Madre mountains in the state of Chihuahua and bids to cut at least 100,000 tonnes of lumber inside one year to be made into cellulose, the daily said.

In a pilot project, International Paper contracted Tarahumara Indians, operating communal farms in the state, to log their lands. The project will be expanded in 1997 to other indigenous tribes to cover 75,000 hectares of forest.
